sources.snippet: Overview sam-3d-body-dinov3 is a promptable model for single-image full-body 3D human mesh recovery developed by facebook. The model estimates human pose including body, feet, and hands based on the Momentum Human Rig (MHR), a parametric mesh representation that decouples skeletal structure from surface shape.
